output.content: I was looking at the pipeline logs for the last three weeks. When the main build finishes, the shadow deployment does not start on its own. There is no trigger set to hand over from the CI/CD pipeline to the shadow environment. A human has to manually run the deployment script in the shadow cluster. I watched the process on Tuesday. The build completed at 02:14. The shadow deployment did not begin until 09:30, when someone typed the command into the terminal. This has been the routine for every weekly model retrain. The shadow instance sits idle for several hours after the build succeeds, waiting for that manual input.
